description: A round cat face with two tall pointed ears set wide on its crown. A small scalloped muzzle sits at the bottom centre with whiskers fanning out on each side.

A long narrow hound head in profile faces down and right beneath a tall curtain of hair. The silky coat drapes from the crown down both sides to the bottom edge, with a single eye mark and a small nose at the snout tip.
A broad domed dog head seen from the front with long floppy ears hanging down both sides. A rounded nose sits at the centre above a short tongue hanging from the mouth.
A wide triangular cat face with large pointed ears and cheeks that narrow to a small chin. A tiny V-shaped nose sits low near the chin with no other features.
A dog head seen from the front with a flat crown and long ears falling past the jaw to the bottom edge. A rounded nose and a split upper lip sit at the centre of the muzzle.
A rounded cave-style pet bed with two pointed cat ears on its roof and a flat base. An arched opening in front reveals a curved cushion inside.
A classic flared bell with a small loop on top and a wide rounded lip along its base.
A rounded pet carrier with an arched handle on top. A horizontal seam divides it into a lid with two vertical vent slots and a tapering lower tray.
A trapezoid pet carrier with an arched handle on top and a horizontal rim across its middle. Two vertical straps run down the front from the upper edge to the base.
A fish faces left with a round eye, a curved gill line and a forked tail. A wavy string rises from its body to the top edge, knotted just above the fish.
A tapered flowerpot with a wide rim holds three straight blades of grass that fan slightly apart as they rise.
A cat head with two pointed ears, a flat top between them and a rounded jaw. Two oval eyes sit above a small T-shaped nose whose line drops to the chin.
A cat head with two pointed ears and a softly rounded jaw. Two oval eyes sit above a small W-shaped smiling mouth.
A rounded mouse body faces right with a figure-eight winding key standing on its back. A long tail curls out from its left end and loops down beneath it.
A plump mouse body faces right with a small pointed ear and a round eye. Two large leaf-shaped plumes splay upward from its rear at the left.
A two-tier cat tree: a rounded top platform on a post above a wider shelf, which stands on posts over a broad base. A curved wand arcs up from the shelf to a small ball toy at the right.
A cat sits upright with two pointed ears on a squared head and a narrow neck. Its body swells into a curved haunch at the left and a straight back edge at the right, resting on a flat base.
A round ball hangs from a straight vertical string, a small bead joining them at its top. A curled feather tail sweeps out from beneath the ball.
A striped yarn ball sits at the lower left with two curved leaf-shaped feathers rising from its upper right. Two short motion dashes trail from its left side.
A round ball of yarn wound with curved diagonal bands. A loose strand leaves its lower right and trails off along the bottom.
A cat sits in profile facing right, with pointed ears, a straight vertical chest and a rounded haunch. Its tail curls up and around from the lower left.
A narrow dog head with very large pointed ears spreading up and out. The face tapers to a small squared muzzle at the bottom without interior features.
A broad fluffy dog face framed by a thick mane with small rounded ears at the top corners. Small eyes and a round muzzle with a nose and tongue sit in the centre above a curved chin line.
A dog head with a domed crown and long wavy ears hanging down both sides. A rounded nose sits above a small split mouth at the bottom centre.
A dog head outline with two large upright pointed ears on a flat crown. Neck lines widen down to the bottom edge, and there are no facial features.
A rounded dog head with long floppy ears that hang to the jaw on both sides. Two small oval eyes sit in the centre above a scalloped chin.
A dog head with a rounded crown, ears folding down both sides and a neck below. Two oval eyes sit above a rounded nose and a split mouth.
A dog stands in profile facing right with its hindquarters supported by a wheeled cart. A large round wheel sits at the lower left, joined by a frame bar to the dog body.
A long narrow dog head seen from the front with two tall cropped pointed ears. The face tapers steeply to a small rounded nose at the bottom.
A dog stretches on a diagonal in mid-leap, its pointed-eared head at the upper right. A small ball sits at the centre of the figure while its legs trail toward the lower left.
A dog head with a pointed ear at the upper right holds a large round ball in its mouth at the left. A bent front leg reaches forward beneath the ball as it trots.
A round collar band seen in perspective as a shallow cylinder. A short stem hangs from the front of the band to a round tag ring.
A friendly dog face with a rounded head and floppy ears flaring out at both sides. Two small eyes sit above a rounded nose and a split mouth.
A wide shallow bowl with sloping sides and a flat base. A lumpy mound of kibble rises above its rim.
A dog sits in profile facing left with a pointed ear and a raised tail. One front leg extends forward and up at the left, offering its paw.
A dog leaps horizontally to the right through a tall oval hoop at the left. Its head and pointed ear lead at the upper right, and its hind legs pass through the hoop.
A leash hangs from a triangular handle loop at the upper left and curves down and right. It ends at the collar of a dog head in profile with a pointed ear, facing right.
A dog lies in profile facing right, its body low and long with a raised tail at the left. Its head rests forward with a floppy ear, and a front paw tucks beneath its chest.
A dog head in profile faces left with pointed upright ears. A basket muzzle with crossed straps covers the snout, and a leash line runs down to the lower right.
A rounded triangular main pad with four oval toe pads arched above it, the two middle toes larger and set higher than the outer two.
The top of a broad dog head with a flat crown and small folded ears curling down at each side. Short jaw lines curve down from beneath the ears, and there are no facial features.
A dog head with a pointed upright ear rises at the upper right, its neck curving down to the left. A large tilted oval disc is held in its mouth at the lower left, with a front leg below.
A dog rises on a diagonal toward a small ball at the upper left, its head and floppy ear lifted and one front leg raised. A long straight line runs from its body down to the lower right.
A person with a round head stands at the left, one arm reaching out and down. A small dog with a floppy ear sits at the lower right beneath the outstretched hand.
A three-tiered swirled pile with a pointed tip at the top. A single wavy odour line rises above it.
A dog head in profile faces left with a pointed ear. A hand with spread fingers rests on the back of its head and neck from the lower right.
A dog sits upright in profile facing right with a pointed ear, a straight chest and a raised tail curving up at the left. Its front leg stands as a separate line beside the haunch.
A small dog stands in profile facing right with a pointed ear, a short straight tail and short legs beneath a long low body.
A single continuous line forms a dog with its head at the top left, a long neck dropping to a rounded chest, and a tail sweeping up to the right. The sparse reference is hard to read.
A dog head and back in profile float above a wavy water line, head at the left with a floppy ear. Its body runs level to the right and dips into the waves.
A dog with a floppy ear sits at the upper right facing left. Its front paw rests on an open palm that reaches in from the lower left.
A dog walks in profile facing right with a floppy ear, a raised tail and one front leg lifted. Its four legs are drawn in stride beneath a level back.
A dog sits upright in profile facing right, with a pointed ear, a raised tail and a rounded haunch. A flat ground line extends beneath its feet.
A wide squarish dog head with small folded ears at the top corners. Heavy drooping jowls wrap a small nose at the centre of the lower face.
A dog head with a pointed upright ear rises at the upper right, its neck curving down to the left. A large tilted oval disc is held in its mouth at the lower left, with a front leg below.
A dog sits upright in profile facing right, with a pointed ear and a tail curving up at the left. Its straight front leg and a small tucked back paw rest on the ground.
A dog stands in profile facing right with a floppy ear, a raised curved tail and four straight legs. Its head is lifted with a squared muzzle.
A broad dog head with a rounded crown and ears folding at the upper sides. Heavy jowls hang in two lobes on either side of a central muzzle line, with a small nose at its top.
A compact dog head with two very large rounded bat ears spreading up and out. A short vertical muzzle line splits the rounded lower face.
A dog head in profile faces right with a round nose, a long floppy ear hanging down its cheek and a curved neck line beneath.
A long dog head seen from the front with two tall pointed cropped ears. The narrow face tapers to a squared muzzle split by a short centre line.
An upright clipper body tapers toward its rounded base, with a comb of five teeth across its top edge. An oval power button sits on the upper front.
A pair of scissors on a diagonal with two round finger loops at the lower left. The open blades spread toward the upper right, one straight and one curved.
A rounded rectangular bottle with a short neck and a pump head whose nozzle points to the right. An oval label mark sits on the front of the bottle.
A large circular running wheel with a hub at its centre stands on an A-frame stand. The stand legs run from the hub through the wheel to a flat base bar.
A dog head with a flat crown and triangular ears folding outward. Two vertical ear lines frame a rounded nose and mouth, and neck lines splay down to the bottom edge.
A cat head outline with two tall ears ending in tufted points, a flat crown between them and shaggy cheek notches. The neck widens down to the bottom edge, and there are no facial features.
A small dog face with very large rounded ears angled up and out. Two oval eyes sit above a small nose on a narrow muzzle.
A round flat cat face with short pointed ears, squinting line eyes and a small W-shaped nose and mouth. Two whiskers extend from each cheek.
A dog head in profile with a pointed ear peeks from inside a wide funnel-shaped cone collar tilted to the right. Two front legs drop straight below the cone.
A rounded triangular main pad with four toe pads above it: two large round inner toes and two smaller oval outer toes.
A brush lies on a diagonal from lower left to upper right with a slender handle and a rounded head. Four short bristle rows project from the upper edge of the head.
A pair of nail clippers stands open with two long handles splaying downward. Their crossed curved jaws meet at the top.
A broad rounded main pad with a notched top, and four oval toe pads arched above it, the two inner toes taller.
A tick seen from above with a small head at the top and a large oval body. Jointed legs curve outward from both sides, the front pair reaching up past the head.
A poodle head with a large cloud-like topknot of fur. Long pom-pom ears hang down both sides of a narrow squared face.
The top of a dog head with a flat crown and folded ears hanging at both corners. Long cheek lines run down the sides to the bottom edge, and there are no facial features.
A wide dog head with a rounded crown and angled sides. Two long jowl lines frame a rounded nose and a split upper lip that drops into two lobes.
A round cat face with small ears folded flat against its crown. Two short stripe marks sit on the forehead, and two whiskers extend from each cheek.
A domed dog head with long hair ears hanging down to the bottom on both sides. Two oval eyes sit above a small nose and a curved mouth.
A cat face with large pointed ears and a wide head narrowing to a small chin. A short nose line drops at the centre, with two whiskers extending from each side.
A dog head with tall pointed ears and a bold mask line sweeping down the cheeks. Two oval eyes sit above a large nose and a smiling mouth.
